# Stable Structure Limited

> Structural and civil engineering consultancy in Botany, Auckland, New Zealand, led by a Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng #1030007). Structural design, PS1 building consent documentation, site inspections, construction monitoring and PS4, retaining walls, pools, decks and portal frames, across Auckland and New Zealand.

Contact: 021 148 8984 · gajan@stablestructure.co.nz · Mon–Fri 8:30am–5pm

## Services
- [Structural Design](https://www.stablestructure.co.nz/services/structural-design.html): Structural design by chartered engineers in Auckland: beams, foundations, bracing and wall removals, with drawings, calcs and PS1. Fixed-fee quotes.
- [Civil Design](https://www.stablestructure.co.nz/services/civil-design.html): Civil engineering in Auckland: stormwater, soakage and tanks, drainage, earthworks, driveways and sediment control, with drawings for consent.
- [Building Consent Documentation](https://www.stablestructure.co.nz/services/building-consent-documentation.html): Consent-ready drawings, calculations and a PS1 signed by a CPEng engineer, with council RFIs answered for you. Fixed fee, quoted within one business day.
- [Site Inspections](https://www.stablestructure.co.nz/services/site-inspections.html): Structural site inspections and PS4 construction review across Auckland: pre-pour and framing inspections, written site records, and the PS4 council needs.
- [Construction Supervision](https://www.stablestructure.co.nz/services/construction-supervision.html): Construction monitoring (CM1 to CM5) in South and East Auckland: stage inspections, written site reports and the PS4 council needs. Fixed-fee quotes.
- [Retaining Walls](https://www.stablestructure.co.nz/services/retaining-walls.html): Retaining wall engineers in Botany, East Auckland. Engineered timber, block and concrete walls, driveway walls, drainage, PS1 and consent. Fixed quotes.
- [Swimming Pools](https://www.stablestructure.co.nz/services/swimming-pools.html): Structural design for in-ground pools in Auckland: pool shells, slopes, retaining, surrounds and barriers, with drawings, calculations and PS1 for consent.
- [Decks & Outdoor Living](https://www.stablestructure.co.nz/services/decks-outdoor-living.html): Deck engineering in Auckland: decks over 1.5 m, cantilevers, spa pool loads and balustrades, with drawings, calculations and PS1. Fixed-fee quotes.
- [Carports, Sheds & Portals](https://www.stablestructure.co.nz/services/carports-sheds-portals.html): Steel and timber portal frames, carports, sheds and rural buildings, designed for NZ wind and earthquake loads, with drawings and PS1 for consent.

## Guides
- [What is a PS1?](https://www.stablestructure.co.nz/guides/what-is-a-ps1.html): What a PS1 producer statement covers, how it differs from a PS4, who can issue one and when your NZ building consent needs it. By a chartered engineer.
- [Retaining wall consent rules](https://www.stablestructure.co.nz/guides/retaining-wall-consent-nz.html): NZ retaining wall consent rules in plain English: the 1.5 metre threshold, what counts as a surcharge, when you need an engineer and how the process works.
- [Deck consent rules](https://www.stablestructure.co.nz/guides/deck-consent-nz.html): When an NZ deck needs building consent or an engineer: the 1.5 metre fall rule, when a barrier is required, cantilevers, spa pools and the process.
- [Removing a load-bearing wall](https://www.stablestructure.co.nz/guides/removing-load-bearing-wall-nz.html): How to tell if a wall is load-bearing, why bracing matters, what the engineer designs and when removing an internal wall needs building consent in NZ.
- [Consent timeframes and RFIs](https://www.stablestructure.co.nz/guides/building-consent-timeframes-auckland.html): Council has 20 working days to decide a building consent, and RFIs pause the clock. What slows Auckland consents, the 12-month lapse rule and code compliance.
